FIELDS.NAME: Luminous Lighting Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Compliance Officer, Luminous Lighting Solutions, (555) 123-4567, johndoe@luminouslights.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Luminous Lighting Solutions specializes in the retail sale of high-quality lighting fixtures, bulbs, and accessories. Our core operations focus on providing an extensive selection of residential and commercial lighting products from our physical storefront, ensuring an engaging shopping experience for our customers. We emphasize excellent product knowledge and customer service, assisting clients in finding the perfect lighting solutions for their needs. While we do provide limited installation services, they account for less than 10% of our total revenue, allowing us to maintain a retail-focused business model. Our inventory is carefully sourced from reputable manufacturers and stored in secure, monitored facilities to prevent theft and loss. We adhere to all relevant safety standards, including UL and ANSI, to guarantee the quality and safety of our lighting products.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Luminous Home Decor LLC, an online retailer of home accessories
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a water leak from a broken pipe caused damage to our inventory of lighting fixtures, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The claim has been reported to our insurance provider and is currently under review.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station monitoring system, security fencing around the property, and patrol services during non-operating hours.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost for new lighting fixtures and supplies.
